About this Event

🪔 The PRYM Group by Bollywood Bash presents

Bollywood Night — Diwali EditionCelebrate the Festival of Lights with Bollywood beats, festive looks, and a night of dancing at Komic Karma Club in North Brunswick! ✨💃
Gather your friends and join DJ Preeti for a high-energy mix of Bollywood favorites, Hindi remixes, Punjabi hits, Bhangra beats, and club anthems. From nostalgic singalongs to dance-floor favorites, get ready to celebrate Diwali together! 🔥
EVENT DETAILS
📅 Friday, November 6, 2026
⏰ 10 PM onwards
📍 Komic Karma Club
774 Shoppes Blvd, North Brunswick Township, NJ 08902
🔞 21+ | Valid physical government-issued photo ID required
👗 DRESS CODE
Festive and traditional attire encouraged! Bring out your sarees, lehengas, kurtas, or favorite party outfit and dress to shine.
🍸 DRINKS
Enjoy drinks available for purchase at the bar. Beverages and bottle service are charged separately unless expressly included in your ticket or package.
🍾 VIP TABLES & BOTTLE SERVICE
Give your crew a dedicated place to celebrate! Contact (201) 954-5839 for table reservations, bottle options, and package pricing.
🎟️ GET YOUR TICKETS
Make your Diwali plans and book your tickets today. Bring your party squad and meet us on the dance floor!
TERMS & CONDITIONS
Age & ID: Guests must be 21 or older and present a valid, physical government-issued photo ID. Photos or digital copies of IDs will not be accepted.Guest Conduct: Please treat fellow guests, staff, and performers respectfully. Harassment, threatening behavior, and disruptive conduct will not be tolerated.Tickets & Refunds: All sales are final. Tickets are non-refundable and non-exchangeable, except where required by law or applicable platform policies.Photography & Video: Photography and filming will take place for event coverage and promotional use. For questions or image-removal requests, contact @bollywoodbas
